categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in green electricity trading, energy-saving services, energy storage services, and energy storage frequency regulation auxiliary services. It also provides integrated energy management services including green electricity trading platforms, energy management systems, and monitoring systems. Additionally, its subsidiary offers corporate energy management, greenhouse gas inventory, verification, carbon neutrality, ESG sustainability reporting, and software services.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced energy engineering technologies, integrated service platforms, and proprietary algorithms for power supply optimization. It employs energy storage system turnkey construction and maintenance, dynamic frequency regulation technologies, and digital cloud services for green electricity sharing. The company also integrates big data, AI, 5G, IoT, and cloud technologies to develop comprehensive green energy management systems.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include renewable energy suppliers, corporate green electricity consumers across industries such as finance, services, telecommunications, software, technology, manufacturing, food, and retail. The company also serves Taiwan Power Company for grid stability services and provides energy-saving engineering services to commercial and industrial clients. Its market includes domestic enterprises committed to RE100 and other sustainability initiatives.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily within Taiwan, serving domestic renewable energy markets and corporate clients. It is actively exploring expansion into Southeast Asia and other international markets with high renewable energy potential. The company leverages its domestic expertise to establish partnerships and brand presence abroad.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy supply chain. It purchases electricity from renewable energy producers (upstream) and resells to end users, while also providing engineering, integration, and energy management services downstream. It acts as a service integrator and platform operator within the green energy ecosystem.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include optimizing power supply matching between renewable generation and consumption, expanding energy storage system integration, and developing smart grid technologies. The company emphasizes digital innovation, including blockchain financial services and AI-driven energy forecasting. It plans to enhance overseas market development and continuously improve service quality and operational efficiency aligned with sustainability goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through green electricity sales, engineering project contracts for energy-saving and energy storage systems, and service fees from energy management and frequency regulation auxiliary services. The company also earns income from software and consulting services related to ESG reporting and carbon management. Its model combines product sales, project-based engineering services, and recurring service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company positions itself as a leading professional energy integration service provider in Taiwan's renewable energy market, with a significant market share in green electricity trading and energy storage auxiliary services. It competes in a highly competitive market with many players but leverages its comprehensive service offerings, technical expertise, and group synergies to maintain a competitive edge. Its market share in certain segments, such as energy storage frequency regulation, is notable.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company has shown strong growth, with revenue increasing from approximately NT$880 million in 2023 to NT$1.89 billion in 2024, reflecting over 100% growth. Assets and liabilities have also increased significantly due to expanded engineering contracts and investments in energy storage projects. The company maintains a stable equity base and has improved profitability, with net income rising by over 50%. It plans further capital increases and financing to support growth.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers one-stop integrated green energy solutions combining green electricity trading, energy-saving engineering, and energy storage services. It differentiates through advanced technology integration, proprietary optimization algorithms, and comprehensive service capabilities from project planning to operation. Its strong industry experience, professional team, and strategic partnerships enable superior service quality and customer trust, supporting clients’ sustainability and energy transition goals.
